يحتمين (form VIII)
# يَحْتَمِينَ (yaḥtamīna) /jaħ.ta.miː.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# يُحْتَمَيْنَ (yuḥtamayna) /juħ.ta.maj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
